scope.pickOneTenant: Select exactly one tenant to work in
scope.pickOneTenantHelp: This screen works in one tenant. Pick one tenant in the tenant filter of the top bar; every read and write goes to that tenant.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.description: The data you asked for was not found or is outside your scope.

errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: This username is already in use.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email is already in use.
errors.ROLE_NOT_FOUND: The role does not exist or you may not grant it.
errors.RETENTION_BELOW_MINIMUM: The gameplay chat retention is below the allowed minimum.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: This feature is temporarily turned off.

fieldErrors.PERMISSION_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_SCOPE: This permission cannot be used in a tenant role.

schools.name: School name
schools.sisReadOnly: Data provided by SIS is read-only here; edit it in SIS or the CSV file.

pending.title: Why it is pending
pending.new: A new school from SIS/CSV must be confirmed by the tenant admin before it becomes active.
pending.noProvince: SIS did not send the school's province.

students.name: Name
students.searchHint: Name, username or student code (at least 2 characters)
students.readOnlyHint: Students belong to one school and one grade, come from SIS/CSV and are read-only. Edit details or change school/grade in SIS or the CSV file.

passwordReset.title: Reset the password of {{name}}
passwordReset.description: The new password of {{username}} is shown only once so you can print the login card. The student's open game session ends.
passwordReset.onceOnly: The password is shown only now; it cannot be seen again after closing.
passwordReset.redacted: The password was already shown before and cannot be displayed again. If it was not noted, reset the password once more.

sis.help: CSV file following the EduWorld SIS Contract (column = data field name), one data kind per file, up to 10 MB. The automatic SIS sync schedule is set by EduWorld per connection; schools using CSV update by uploading a new file.
sis.dryRunHelp: A dry run only checks and counts changes; nothing is applied.

fileProblems.too_large: The file is larger than allowed.
fileProblems.name_too_long: The file name is too long.

problems.too_large: The file is larger than allowed.
problems.name_too_long: The file name is too long.
problems.upload_expired: The upload link has expired. Upload again to create a new import.
problems.upload_failed: The upload failed. Check the network and try again.
problems.api: The import could not be created.

final.completed_with_issues: Import completed with conflicts to resolve in the Sync conflicts tab.
final.failed: The import failed. Check the file and upload again.
final.expired: The upload link has expired. Upload again to create a new import.

typeAdvice.possible_duplicate: Check both records in SIS; if it is the same person, fix it at the source.
typeAdvice.school_province_missing: Select the province when approving the school.
typeAdvice.unmapped_school: Contact EduWorld to map the school.
typeAdvice.cleaned_up_student_in_sis: Check the student in SIS; the student is restored when signing in again.
typeAdvice.duplicate_identifier: Change the username/email in SIS/CSV so it does not clash with another account.
typeAdvice.deactivation_review: Confirm in SIS that the student left.
typeAdvice.school_duplicate: Contact the tenant admin to merge the schools.
typeAdvice.unexpected_org_member: Check the member list in SIS.

suggestions.fix_in_source: Fix the data in SIS/CSV and import again.

recon.mergeHint: Both accounts are the same student: a System Admin merges them after review; the conflict stays open until then.

users.emailUnverifiedNote: The new email stays unverified on the sign-in system (SSO) until the user confirms it. The username cannot change; create a new account for another username.
users.reloaded: The account was just changed by someone else; the list was reloaded.
users.takenHint: If this is the same person working in another unit, grant a role to the existing account instead of creating a new one.

userRoles.title: Roles of {{name}}
userRoles.effectiveWithin: The change applies to the user within {{seconds}} seconds.
userRoles.targetRequired: Select the target of the scope.

roles.name: Name
roles.impact: {{count}} people hold this role; changes apply within the permission refresh time.
roles.deleteConflict: The role is still granted to people. Revoke its UserRoles before deleting it.

settings.cleanupDays: Days without login before a student is cleaned up
settings.cleanupDaysHelp: 0 = off; empty = EduWorld default. Editable only when EduWorld lets the unit override it.
settings.cleanupWarning: A low number of days may clean up students away for the summer holiday. Consider a larger value.
settings.chatRetentionHelp: Empty = EduWorld default; not below the minimum.

curfew.title: Curfew
curfew.platformNote: Set by EduWorld, applies to game and chat for every student.
curfew.mustCover: The school window must contain the whole EduWorld curfew (it can only be extended).
curfew.reloaded: The settings were just changed by someone else; the new values were reloaded.

dailyLimit.title: Daily play limit
dailyLimit.common: Not applied to the common tenant
dailyLimit.note: Applies to every student of the school, on the total game time of the day (Vietnam time). At the limit students are warned, their session ends and they can come back from 00:00 the next day.

cleanup.tooMany: Select at most {{max}} students at a time.

trash.help: Soft-deleted records of the unit. Restoring needs a reason; there is no permanent delete.
trash.notRestorable: A newer record has the same code — cannot be restored.
